suggestions.action: Significantly reduce or pause the production and auto-publishing of daily quiz reels. Reallocate resources to increase the frequency of "news recap reels".
suggestions.why: Quiz reels perform poorly (e.g., "HPCL Quiz Challenge" 0 views YT). News reels dominate views (e.g., "CIL MT 2026 Exam" 9427 views YT).

suggestions.action: Refine the hook-line pool and title formulas for "news recap reels" to consistently use urgent, outcome-driven language and highlight numbers (e.g., "OUT!", "Declared!", "X posts!").
suggestions.why: Top news reels use urgent hooks (e.g., "CIL MT 2026 Exam: August dates out!", "1,731 dreams fulfilled! SSC JE 2025 Final Result").

suggestions.action: Conduct an A/B test for Hinglish vs. English voiceovers on top-performing "news recap reels" to determine audience preference and engagement lift.
suggestions.why: Data on Hinglish news reels is too thin for conclusive impact (e.g., "CBSE 10th marks badhne waale hain?" 186 views YT). Need more data.

suggestions.action: Update Gemini prompts for Instagram captions to explicitly include calls-to-action for likes and comments, and experiment with interactive elements within video templates.
suggestions.why: Instagram engagement is low; top-viewed reels rarely exceed 3 likes or 0 comments (e.g., "SSC CGL 2026" 125 views, 3 likes).

suggestions.action: Immediately pause or drastically reduce the production and daily rotation of all vertical-specific daily quiz reels for all exam categories.
suggestions.why: Quiz reels consistently show abysmal performance on YouTube, receiving 0-12 views (e.g., 'HPCL Quiz Challenge': 0 views).

suggestions.action: Allocate resources saved from quiz reels to significantly increase the volume and frequency of news recap reels, focusing on results, admit cards, and exam dates.
suggestions.why: News recaps generate the vast majority of views on YouTube (e.g., CIL MT: 6885 views, AIBE: 2939 views, JEECUP: 2562 views).

suggestions.action: Standardize YouTube title formulas for news recaps to prominently feature urgent keywords like 'OUT!', 'LIVE!', 'Declared!', 'Released!' early in the title.
suggestions.why: Top performing videos heavily feature these urgent keywords (e.g., 'CIL MT 2026 Exam: August dates out!': 6885 views).

suggestions.action: Implement A/B testing for cover/thumbnail frame choices and Hinglish vs English voiceovers specifically for news recap reels on Instagram.
suggestions.why: Instagram performance is very low (max 148 views) compared to YouTube, but data is thin for specific content-based reasons.

suggestions.action: Revamp per-vertical hashtag sets, creating a primary set for urgent exam news relevant across all currently uncategorized 'unknown' news reels.
suggestions.why: Top YouTube news videos are largely uncategorized ('unknown' vertical), showing a need for relevant cross-vertical news hashtags.

suggestions.action: Immediately pause daily quiz reel publication. Reallocate resources to news recap reel production, focusing on "Result OUT", "Admit Card", "Answer Key" updates.
suggestions.why: Quiz reels consistently show extremely low engagement across platforms (e.g., YouTube: 11 views; Instagram: 0 views).

suggestions.action: Standardize news recap hook lines, titles, and IG captions to include high-impact keywords like "OUT", "LIVE", "Declared", "Admit Card", "Answer Key", and direct calls-to-action like "Download Now!".
suggestions.why: Urgent, actionable news recaps drive high views (e.g., "FRI Dehradun Answer Key": 631 views, "BPSC APO Admit Card": 235 views).

suggestions.action: Explicitly review and refine Gemini-written Instagram captions and per-vertical hashtag sets for news recap reels, ensuring they mirror high-performing YouTube titles and tactics (e.g., emojis).
suggestions.why: Some news recaps get 0 views on Instagram despite similar videos performing on YouTube (e.g., "Bombay High Court Clerk Result": YT 74 views vs IG 0 views).

suggestions.action: Mandate vertical assignment for all new video publications, eliminating "unknown" categorization, particularly for news recap reels, to improve content analysis.
suggestions.why: Many high-performing news recaps are tagged "unknown". Accurate tagging will enhance future performance analysis and content strategy.
